judged_text: The handler inserts plain Attendee rows unconditionally and never branches on booking.eventType.seatsPerTimeSlot (even though it copies seatsPerTimeSlot into evt on line 145), so seat-based event types fall through a guest path designed for ordinary bookings. On a seated event type, addGuests bypasses the seatsPerTimeSlot capacity check and creates attendee records the BookingSeat-based seats system does not recognize: a fully-booked seated event accepts unlimited 'guests' who each get a confirmation email while seat counts in the seats UI stay unchanged.

adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the mutation always appends to booking.attendees via prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}}) and never checks booking.eventType.seatsPerTimeSlot or any capacity/seat allocation before adding guests, even though it forwards seatsPerTimeSlot/seatsShowAttendees into the CalendarEvent (evt). The diff does not show how seated bookings are enforced/stored elsewhere, so the stronger claims about a separate BookingSeat system/UI not recognizing these rows aren’t directly verifiable from the diff, but the missing seats/capacity handling for seat-based event types is a concrete, diff-grounded edge case created by this change.
